title: Modify pending order: payment method
description: Encodes the retail agent policy subsection 'Modify pending order -> Modify payment' as a permission decision over a single pending order.

decision.intent: Let a retail agent determine, before touching the database, whether the policy permits changing the payment method recorded on a specific pending order.
decision.question: May this order's payment method be modified?

evidenceRequirements.description: The user's explicit 'yes' confirming the listed payment-method change. The policy phrases the change as taking effect 'After user confirmation', so confirmation is a precondition to executing a permitted change; it is not a condition on whether the policy permits the change.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Modify pending order (status gate)

citation.excerpt: An order can only be modified if its status is 'pending', and you should check its status before taking the action.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Modify pending order (permitted modifications)

citation.excerpt: For a pending order, you can take actions to modify its shipping address, payment method, or product item options, but nothing else.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Modify payment (single, different method)

citation.excerpt: The user can only choose a single payment method different from the original payment method.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Modify payment (gift card balance)

citation.excerpt: If the user wants the modify the payment method to gift card, it must have enough balance to cover the total amount.

sources.title: Retail agent policy - Modify payment (confirmation and post-action effects)

citation.location: ### Modify payment, third and fourth sentences
citation.excerpt: After user confirmation, the order status will be kept as 'pending'. The original payment method will be refunded immediately if it is a gift card, otherwise it will be refunded within 5 to 7 business days.

outcomes.label: Payment method modification permitted
outcomes.description: Policy permits changing this pending order's payment method to the single requested method. The agent must still list the action details and obtain the user's explicit 'yes' before executing; the order status stays 'pending' and the original payment method is refunded immediately for a gift card, otherwise within 5 to 7 business days.

outcomes.label: Payment method modification denied
outcomes.description: Policy does not permit this payment-method change. The agent should deny the request and explain which policy condition failed.

rules.description: Permit the change when the order is pending, exactly one new payment method is chosen, it differs from the original payment method, and - if it is a gift card - its balance covers the order total.
rules.rationale: The subsection permits exactly one payment-method substitution on a pending order, subject to the gift-card funding test. Every stated condition must hold, so the permission rule is a conjunction and any unavailable fact leaves the permission undetermined rather than granted.

rules.description: Deny when the order status is anything other than 'pending'.
rules.rationale: 'An order can only be modified if its status is pending' is an absolute gate; a processed, delivered, cancelled, or items-modified order cannot have its payment method changed.

rules.description: Deny when the user asks to settle the order with a number of payment methods other than exactly one.
rules.rationale: 'The user can only choose a single payment method' rules out splitting the order total across several methods and rules out a request that names none.

rules.description: Deny when the requested payment method is the order's original payment method.
rules.rationale: 'different from the original payment method' forbids a no-op substitution back onto the method already charged.

rules.description: Deny when the requested method is a gift card whose balance does not cover the order total.
rules.rationale: The balance test is stated only for gift cards, so it gates nothing when the requested method is a paypal account or a credit card.

escalation.message: The payment-method change on this pending order cannot be settled within the agent's scope: a required fact could not be determined, the encoded rules disagree, or no rule applied. Call transfer_to_human_agents and then send 'YOU ARE BEING TRANSFERRED TO A HUMAN AGENT. PLEASE HOLD ON.'
